article.story: HANOVER, N.H. -- — Kenny Noland scored 29 points as Columbia beat Dartmouth 79-69 on Saturday. Noland added 10 rebounds and four steals for the Lions (13-6, 2/3 Ivy League). Hampton Sanders scored 16 points, going 5 of 8 from the floor, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and 3 for 4 from the line. Blair Thompson added 10 points. The Big Green (9-9, 3-2) were led by Brandon Mitchell-Day, who posted 20 points and 11 rebounds. Connor Amundsen added 13 points, six assists and two steals for Dartmouth. Jackson Munro finished with 13 points and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
